issues.finding: All five image headers show 2010, not 2025. Synthetic extraction cases; not a valid oracle for fiscal computation or current-year tax rules.

Each image has Copy B and Copy C of the same W2. Count as one document, one page, one taxpayer statement; never sum duplicated copies. Both copies have matching inspected values. Evidence can identify box alone; do not require one of two equivalent copies unless task says so.

Source encodes blank text fields as literal string None; images show blanks. Existing evaluator does not support null. Exclude blank box9 and blank box12 codes from initial scored fields; do not treat string None or numeric 0 as a faithful extraction of blank.
Normalize x to true and None to false ONLY for three box13 checkboxes; visual checks confirm all15 checkbox states.
box_15_[1,2]_employee_state_id refers to Employers state ID number, not employee ID. If included later, use employer_state_id and preserve hyphens and leading zeros as string.
Source box_e_employee_*address and city_state_zip refer to employee address labelled f in image. Employee name is e. Do not require evidence box e for address.
Use canonical names medicare_tax_withheld, statutory_employee, third_party_sick_pay for source box6/13 keys; keep source mapping in provenance.

JPG files are raster images (612x792). Existing PDF text extraction alone cannot access them. Use explicitly verified vision/OCR or audited image-preserving PDF plus OCR; never provide source GT as extracted text.
Normalize JSON ints/floats with Decimal(str(value)) to two-decimal strings; preserve observed amounts. Scientific/fiscal plausibility is not validated; generated source amounts may be unrealistic.

Visual page1 header and instructions show2025 while footer says Form592-B2024. Text extraction first excerpt starts with stale footer. Do not infer document year from first extracted match or filename. Template excluded from scoring.

official.conclusion: 37 downloaded blank form templates have zero filled AcroForm values; two reference documents are VITA educational material and NJ1065 instructions. Field catalogues are schemas, not expected case outputs. No official PDF is presently a machine-labelled populated benchmark case.

extractbench.conclusion: 77 manifest pointers plus readmes, findings and license only. No source PDF or per-case expected output locally; cannot run/evaluate these entries. Downloader exists but network path was explicitly not revalidated by source kit. Separate acquisition and GT audit required.

recommended_initial_subset.scope: 5 synthetic image extraction cases, each with22 money amounts,3 booleans,2 state strings,2 locality strings,nonblank box12 code strings andtax_year2010. Identification/name/address/control fields excluded by choice; null fields excluded for existing schema compatibility.
recommended_initial_subset.not_runtime_ready_until: Native adapters have a tested image/OCR input path, or field-verified OCR derivatives are explicitly declared as a separate text scenario.

executable_projection.scope: Extraction labels only. Runtime raster support and vision/OCR validation handled separately.
